title: The Glow

draws.name: The Felled Titan
draws.make_up: A fallen giant stalk baked into the heightmap as a 2.8 km land berm across the main slough (terrain, dressed with simple rock and bark objects, no roof); the new build is a Droid-Factory-class bio-lab at its west root plate (about 300 x 250 m)
draws.story_reason: The CIS harvest the Titan's spores here; the berm is the only dry crossing of the main slough

draws.name: The Spore Citadel
draws.make_up: A Droid-Factory-class lab citadel on the north rise; the planet's ONE capstone interior is inside
draws.story_reason: Where the spore weapon is cultured; the end of the run

draws.name: The Canal Lock
draws.make_up: CIS Fortress Dam as the canal lock + levee bunkers + pump house
draws.story_reason: The lock carries the only paved road north on the east side

draws.name: The Spore Ridge Grove
draws.make_up: CIS Small Citadel + Large Power Facility among giant-flora dressing on the limestone ridge
draws.story_reason: The ridge forest's spore labs and the west's only high ground

draws.name: The Lake Hover Base
draws.make_up: CIS Elevated Landing Pads + Vehicle Depot + Covered AA on the south lake shore
draws.story_reason: The droid hover fleet's base; it holds the lake, the Republic's way in

draws.name: The Cenote Caves
draws.make_up: PLAD Cave Base + Royal Tunnel Holdout in a ring of sinkholes
draws.story_reason: Spore stores hidden in the sinkhole caves; the map's tunnel site
